title: Northgate Tire Center Loyalty Pricing — Repeat Rotation Visit Rates
content:
# Repeat rotation visit rates

**Notice.** A Northgate Tire Center rotation charge carries a loyalty rate read from the count of rotation-and-balancing charges booked on the package with a service date within the last 12 whole calendar months before today; a charge dated 12 or more whole months ago does not count.

| Rotation-and-balancing charges dated within the last 12 whole months | Loyalty rate |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 0.75 |
| exactly 1 | 0.9 |
| none | 1 — the full rate |

**How the rate acts.** The rotation charge is multiplied by the loyalty rate. The rate acts on the unrounded charge, and the charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Which charges count (hypothetical: today is 2026-10-05)

| Rotation charge dated | Whole months before today | Counted |
|---|---|---|
| 2026-04-12 | 5 | yes |
| 2025-10-06 | 11 | yes |
| 2025-10-05 | 12 | no |

With the three charges above on the package, two are counted and the rate is 0.75; a $30.00 rotation charge before this rate becomes $22.50.
